# janiform-event-log

Structured run event logs, latest-state snapshots, and replay support for Janiform.

This crate is an internal component of [Janiform](https://github.com/lejmer/janiform). Its Rust API may change as the
workspace evolves.

This version is `0.1.0`. The source for this crate lives [here](https://github.com/lejmer/janiform/blob/main/crates/janiform-event-log).
